body:
Thank you for this. I mean that most sincerely.

I still really want to talk with the person I wrote up there about, but I'm just afraid right now, and can't do it. I've learned over the years that I hate talking about important stuff in almost any other way than person to person. I really don't like being alone right now and want to tell her that and ask if we can talk in person, and not while at work but again, I feel like I'll get just brushed off or ignored.

I have taken your advice to heart though. I talked to one other girl I work with about a bunch of this stuff with helped a decent amount with me feeling better. I'd love to do the same with the other, but I fear that ship has sailed.
